market_question: SCOTUS accepts sports event contract case by July 31, 2026?
reasoning: SCOTUS grants cert in only ~1.5% of petitions; a sports-event-contracts case is narrow and lacks a clear circuit split. Pending litigation (e.g., CFTC rule challenges) is unlikely to reach the cert stage before July 2026, making a 13.5% implied probability appear overinflated.
evidence_points: Annual certiorari grants typically represent 1–2% of all petitions.
Major pending cases (like Kalshi v. CFTC) concern political, not sports, contracts; no definitive appellate decision on sports is imminent.
The deadline (<19 months) leaves very little time for a final appellate ruling, cert petition, and grant.
sources_consulted: Docket records for CFTC v. KalshiEX and related event-contract litigation
Legal news and analysis on CFTC rulemaking
